author: Claude, 9 Nov 2026
status: frozen BEFORE any app/detector output for the JH photos was opened (geometry from images only; no labels, no OCR)
question: Does the unchanged app pipeline (mobile_det -> group -> order -> quad crop -> S1) avoid the dataset-crop failure on JH sentence photos, and where does it go wrong?
photos: JH_datasetNov5Sentence/Photo1-7.jpg (EXIF orientation 0); 59 dataset sentence lines (writer JH, jhs) located in them

correspondence.placement: each dataset crop located in its photo by SIFT (ratio 0.75) + RANSAC similarity: 59/59 placed, 160-460 inliers, scale 1.590 +- 0.0003, rotation 0.00 deg (dataset crops are upright cuts); visual overview placement_overview.jpg
correspondence.line_geometry: core_quad: the contiguous band of rows around the ink-profile peak (>= 25% of peak) of the straightened crop, mapped back through the deskew rotation and the placement; checked visually; no two cores overlap
correspondence.link_rule: an app region and a dataset line are linked if intersection / area(core) >= 0.2 OR intersection / area(region) >= 0.5 (convex hulls); recognised text never used
correspondence.components: one_to_one | merge (one region, several lines) | split (one line, several regions) | many_to_many | missed line (no region) | extra region (no dataset line: may be writing that was never cropped, residue or non-board content - not automatically a false detection)
correspondence.raw_vs_grouped: computed for raw detector boxes and for the grouped boxes S1 reads, so grouping effects are separated from detector effects

recognition: ONLY one_to_one lines: CER of the app reading vs label, compared with the same line read from the dataset crop (original, tightened, straightened) by the SAME app reader object on the Mac; labels used only after correspondence
kept_separate: missed, merged and split lines are reported as detection/grouping outcomes (their joined text is shown, not mixed into recognition CER)
geometry_checks: per app crop: width at 64 px, residual ink slope, fraction of the core covered (possible cut-off)
metric: line CER lower-case, collapsed spaces (notebook 14 normalisation); per-line mean; with only 7 photos, intervals are photo-cluster bootstrap and indicative only
caveats: JH sentence crops are development data; dataset lines may not cover all writing on the board; labels unchanged
constraints: no training, no app change, no reading-order work, labels not used to choose boxes
